name: 黑粉束腰滑雪连体衣
nameEn: Black & Pink Corset One-Piece Ski Suit
description:
黑色修身滑雪连体衣，一件就是一整套，粉色豹纹翻领、胸前两颗粉色爱心和一排金色纽扣，束腰式剪裁很显身材；背后还有一颗粉色豹纹爱心。时髦又专业，适合双板。

## 面料与科技
- 三层复合面料，表面 Teflon® 涂层，防水、防油污
- 静水压 ≥20000mmH₂O（JIS L1092）
- 透湿量 ≥20000 g/m²·24h（JIS L1099）
- 耐磨 ≥15000 次（JIS L1096）
- 400 克绗缝棉填充，保暖锁温

## 设计细节
- 束腰式上身剪裁，修身显腰线
- 粉色豹纹翻领，背后粉色豹纹爱心
- 全身接缝压胶，雪水不易渗入
- 大腿内侧透气拉链，热了可以散热
- 袖口、裤脚防风设计
- 反向拉链口袋，内附雪镜擦拭布
- 只能手洗，不可漂白、熨烫，阴凉处晾干
descriptionEn:
A slim-fit black one-piece — a complete outfit in one — with a pink leopard-print collar, two pink heart patches on the chest and a row of gold buttons. The corset-inspired bodice gives it a flattering, body-hugging shape, and there's a pink leopard heart on the back. Stylish and built for skiing.

## Fabric & Tech
- 3-layer composite fabric with Teflon® coating — waterproof and oil-resistant
- Waterproof rating ≥20,000 mmH₂O (JIS L1092)
- Breathability ≥20,000 g/m²/24h (JIS L1099)
- Abrasion resistance ≥15,000 cycles (JIS L1096)
- 400 g quilted insulation for warmth

## Design Details
- Corset-inspired bodice that defines the waist
- Pink leopard-print collar and heart patch on the back
- Fully taped seams to keep out snowmelt
- Inner-thigh vents to cool down
- Windproof cuffs and leg openings
- Reverse-zip pockets with a built-in goggle cleaning cloth
- Hand wash only; no bleach or ironing; hang dry in the shade

name: 复古水手服滑雪套装
description:
复古水手风滑雪套装：白色连帽外套 + 藏青色背带雪裤。经典水手领和领巾，袖子两侧是水手风荷叶袖，背带裤背后还有一颗白色爱心。单板、双板都适合。

## 面料与科技
- 3L 技术面料，防水、透气
- 薄款外壳，没有填充棉，里面按天气叠穿保暖层

## 设计细节
- 加宽加深的立体帽子，可以套在头盔外面，带调节抽绳
- 经典水手领，袖子两侧水手风荷叶袖
- 外套：全身接缝压胶、腋下透气拉链、可调抽绳、防风袖口、防雪裙，雪卡袋里附雪镜擦拭布
- 背带裤：反向拉链口袋防进雪、腰部背带可调、大腿内侧透气拉链、裤脚可以套在雪鞋外、防风裤脚
- 只能手洗，不可漂白、熨烫，阴凉处晾干
descriptionEn:
A vintage sailor-inspired set: white hooded jacket + navy bib pants. Classic sailor collar and neckerchief, flutter-sleeve details on both sides, and a white heart on the back of the bibs. Great for snowboarding or skiing.

## Fabric & Tech
- 3L technical fabric, waterproof and breathable
- Lightweight shell with no insulation — layer underneath to suit the weather

## Design Details
- Extra-roomy hood that fits over a helmet, with adjustable drawcords
- Classic sailor collar and flutter-sleeve details
- Jacket: fully taped seams, underarm vents, adjustable drawcords, windproof cuffs, powder skirt, and a goggle cleaning cloth in the ski pass pocket
- Bib pants: reverse-zip pockets that keep snow out, adjustable straps, inner-thigh vents, leg openings that fit over ski boots, windproof cuffs
- Hand wash only; no bleach or ironing; hang dry in the shade
